snippet.title: Pokémon Pokopia Expansion Pass – Nintendo Direct 6.9.2026
snippet.description:
The Pokémon Pokopia Expansion Pass paid DLC is available for purchase today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/pokemon-pokopia-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Part 1: Bubbly Basin of the Expansion Pass paid DLC is planned for release this August!  Enjoy an underwater town, with new Pokémon to encounter, furniture, and outfits for Ditto.

A free update is also coming to Pokémon Pokopia this August that adds a new move: Dive. With Dive, you’ll be able to explore the world on the ocean floor and enjoy a life with Pokémon living under the sea.

#NintendoDirect #PokemonPokopia #NintendoSwitch2

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
